messages:
ben: Quick check — I'm OOO Apr 24-28. Need someone to chair the ARB slot on May 3 (we usually meet Wed ~15:00 PT). Also two RFCs want ~20m each: `sharding-patterns` and `smart-routing-policy`. Can volunteers claim a chair and reviewers?

maria: I can chair May 3. Happy to timebox to 45m and prioritize sharding then routing.

kevin: if maria chairs I can present smart-routing and add the PR link: https://r.dev/rfcs/234

sasha: prefer sharding gets 30m, routing 20m. Also can anyone do pre-read comments by Tue so we don't cross-talk in meeting?

carla: small ask — can we move to 15:30 PT? I'm in a back-to-back otherwise.

maria: 15:30 works for me.

deploy-bot: calendar invite created: ARB — May 3 15:30 PT. Agenda doc pinned: https://docs.redwood/arb/may3-agenda 

ben: awesome. maria pls add reviewer list. sasha pls post pre-read checklist like: `1) read RFC, 2) add major open Qs, 3) label "must-discuss"`

sasha: will do, I'll ping eng-oncall for perf data and attach perf notes to the agenda.

kevin: added reviewers @carla @maria @sasha and uploaded perf test artifacts to the doc (see section 2).

carla: FYI I'll be ~10m late, but can cover ops impact and migration notes.

maria: cool — I'll run sig-check, keep clocks, and call time if we overrun. please keep slides to 3–4 slides per RFC.

ben: thanks everyone :thumbsup: See you May 3. If anyone needs to swap chair, ping me and I'll reassign.
